bio.text: Heather Hora is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 92 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.
The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Hora as a farmer born in 1970 who lives in Washington, and as a former member of the Iowa Pork Producers Association Board.
